description:
The surah that opens with a riveting description of **The Splitting** of the sky and the levelling of the earth as a sign of the commencement of the Day of Resurrection. It is named after the "splitting open" (inshiqāq) of the sky mentioned in verse 1. The surah deals with the inevitability of man's meeting with his Lord on the Day of Judgement. The obedience of the sky and earth is contrasted with the disobedience of the disbelievers. The reaction of the believers and of the disbelievers on the Day of Judgement is described.
The surah is also known as Bursting Asunder, Ripped Apart, Splitting Open, The Bursting, The Cleaving, The Rending, The Rending Asunder

translations.1: When the sky is split open
translations.2: and gives ear to its Lord as it should.
translations.3: When the earth is spread out
translations.4: and throws out what is in it, emptying itself,
translations.5: and gives ear to its Lord as it should.
translations.6:
O man!
 You are labouring toward your Lord laboriously,
  and you will encounter Him.
translations.7:
Then as for him who is given his record
   in his right hand,
translations.8: he shall soon receive an easy reckoning,
translations.9: and he will return to his folks joyfully.
translations.10:
But as for him who is given his record
  from behind his back,
translations.12: and he will enter the Blaze.
translations.13: Indeed he used to be joyful among his folk,
translations.14: and indeed he thought he would never return.
translations.15: Yes indeed, his Lord sees him best.
translations.16: So I swear by the evening glow,
translations.17: by the night and what it is fraught with,
translations.18: by the moon when it blooms full:
translations.19: you will surely fare from stage to stage.
translations.20:
So what is the matter with them
  that they will not believe?
translations.21:
And when the Qur'ān is recited to them
  they will not prostrate?
translations.23: and Allah knows best what they keep to themselves.
translations.24: So warn them of a painful punishment,
translations.25:
except such as are faithful
   and do righteous deeds:
  there will be an everlasting reward for them.
